note: Paired seeded corpus across languages. Each case carries its own `language`. Vulnerable variants -> potentially_exploitable; fixed -> likely_not_exploitable. Truth is for scoring only. The `-fixed` variants are `neutralized`, not `unreachable` and not plain `reachable`: untrusted input does arrive at the sink, and a named control on the path stops it. `unreachable` is reserved for the one case where no untrusted value reaches the sink at all. The distinction decides whether the probe runs, so it is ground truth rather than wording. Variant directories are named `a` and `b` per topic; which one is exploitable is recorded only in this manifest and in the maintainers' answer key in README.md, and must never be copied into agent inputs. Both findings of a pair share their title and description.
